presentation.short_description: Removes and reinstalls the isolated dual in-line memory module (DIMM) so both retaining latches engage and the module follows the approved population map.

steps_summary: Record the module and slot, then de-energize the server.
Apply electrostatic-discharge controls and inspect the slot and contacts.
Reinstall the module evenly until both latches engage.
entities.education_text: Do not touch module contacts or force a keyed module; follow the server service procedure.

De-energize and apply electrostatic-discharge controls required by the service procedure.
Install the compatible replacement and restore the documented population.
entities.education_text: Module type, rank, capacity, and population rules are platform-specific; do not substitute by connector fit alone.

entities.education_text: Never assume a redundant supply makes replacement safe; required load, feed, and hot-swap conditions vary by platform.

presentation.short_description: POST Verification confirms the repaired state.

illustration.alt_text: Technical reference illustration for POST Verification.

success_conditions: Original fault condition no longer appears and required operation succeeds.
entities.education_text: Verification evaluates whether the repair produced the required operational state.

presentation.short_description: Runs the approved full memory diagnostic and a representative workload, requiring expected capacity with no new reportable memory errors or instability.

illustration.alt_text: Neutral post-repair measurement setup for Memory Verification, without indicating a pass or failure.
illustration.caption: Canonical verify illustration for Memory Verification.
illustration.license_note: Generated for TASK-011 with OpenAI built-in image generation; repository use follows applicable OpenAI terms and the repository license.

success_conditions: The full approved memory diagnostic completes.
Expected memory capacity and channels remain available.
No new reportable corrected or uncorrected memory errors, crashes, or resets occur during the acceptance interval.
entities.education_text: Error-correcting code (ECC) thresholds and the required observation interval are platform policy; record both with the result.

presentation.short_description: Checks firmware and operating-system memory inventory after restart, requiring the expected dual in-line memory modules (DIMMs), capacity, and channels with no population warning.

illustration.alt_text: Neutral post-repair measurement setup for Memory Inventory Verification, without indicating a pass or failure.
illustration.caption: Canonical verify illustration for Memory Inventory Verification.
illustration.license_note: Generated for TASK-011 with OpenAI built-in image generation; repository use follows applicable OpenAI terms and the repository license.

success_conditions: Every expected DIMM appears in the documented slot.
Total capacity and available channels match the approved configuration.
No population or seating warning returns after restart.
entities.education_text: Inventory verifies presence and layout, not sustained memory reliability; use the full memory verification when the fault requires it.

presentation.short_description: Exercises repeated starts and a representative load while requiring healthy power-supply status, stable power, and the intended redundancy with no recurring alert.

illustration.alt_text: Neutral post-repair measurement setup for Stable Power Verification, without indicating a pass or failure.
illustration.caption: Canonical verify illustration for Stable Power Verification.
illustration.license_note: Generated for TASK-011 with OpenAI built-in image generation; repository use follows applicable OpenAI terms and the repository license.

success_conditions: Cold starts complete repeatedly without the original power symptom.
Power-supply and power-good status remain healthy during representative load.
Required redundancy is restored and no new target event appears.
entities.education_text: Use platform-defined load, redundancy, and observation criteria rather than a brief idle check.

presentation.short_description: Checks firmware, controller, and operating-system inventory across restart, requiring the expected storage device and path with no new input/output errors.

illustration.alt_text: Neutral post-repair measurement setup for Storage Detection Verification, without indicating a pass or failure.
illustration.caption: Canonical verify illustration for Storage Detection Verification.
illustration.license_note: Generated for TASK-011 with OpenAI built-in image generation; repository use follows applicable OpenAI terms and the repository license.

success_conditions: The expected device appears at every required inventory layer.
Serial, bay, capacity, and path match the recorded replacement or reconnection.
No new input/output error or missing-device event occurs during the acceptance check.
entities.education_text: Detection alone does not establish media health or array redundancy; run the fault-specific storage verification when required.

presentation.short_description: Monitors the redundant array of independent disks (RAID) until every required member is online, rebuild work is complete, and redundancy is restored without new controller or media alerts.

illustration.alt_text: Neutral post-repair measurement setup for RAID Healthy Verification, without indicating a pass or failure.
illustration.caption: Canonical verify illustration for RAID Healthy Verification.
illustration.license_note: Generated for TASK-011 with OpenAI built-in image generation; repository use follows applicable OpenAI terms and the repository license.

success_conditions: The array reports its approved optimal or healthy state.
Every required member is online and any rebuild is complete.
No new controller, media, or predictive alert occurs during the acceptance interval.
entities.education_text: Do not call a rebuilding or merely accessible array healthy; preserve the final controller report and member map.

presentation.short_description: Performs normal cold and warm starts and checks that firmware selects the intended boot entry, the operating-system loader starts, and the original boot error does not recur.

illustration.alt_text: Neutral post-repair measurement setup for Normal Boot Verification, without indicating a pass or failure.
illustration.caption: Canonical verify illustration for Normal Boot Verification.
illustration.license_note: Generated for TASK-011 with OpenAI built-in image generation; repository use follows applicable OpenAI terms and the repository license.

success_conditions: The intended persistent boot entry is selected.
The operating-system loader and required operating environment start normally.
The original missing-device, wrong-device, or loader error does not recur.
entities.education_text: A one-time boot override is not proof that the persistent boot order is corrected.

presentation.short_description: Firmware Persistence Verification confirms the repaired state.

success_conditions: Original fault condition no longer appears and required operation succeeds.
entities.education_text: Verification evaluates whether the repair produced the required operational state.

presentation.short_description: Applies an approved representative load while monitoring temperatures, fan response, and stability, requiring no thermal alert, throttling outside policy, shutdown, or reset.

illustration.caption: Canonical verify illustration for Thermal Load Verification.
illustration.license_note: Generated for TASK-011 with OpenAI built-in image generation; repository use follows applicable OpenAI terms and the repository license.

success_conditions: Temperatures remain within platform limits for the acceptance interval.
Fan response is stable and no target thermal alert returns.
The server completes the representative workload without thermal shutdown or reset.
entities.education_text: Use platform-specific sensor limits, workload, duration, and stop conditions; protect production data before stressing the server.

presentation.short_description: Observes stable Ethernet carrier at the expected speed and duplex while counters remain within the approved error threshold.

success_conditions: Carrier remains present through the acceptance interval.
Negotiated speed and duplex match the approved link.
No disqualifying error-counter growth or link transition occurs.
entities.education_text: Stable link does not prove address configuration or application connectivity; those require separate checks.

The local gateway and required remote destination are reachable by approved probes.
The required network service succeeds without the original connectivity symptom.
entities.education_text: A single Internet Control Message Protocol (ICMP) reply is not enough; verify the actual service and path required by the work order.
